descriptionChirho: To count, number, or muster persons or things (Qal active); Arabic عَدَّ / أحصى, Korean 세다/계수하다, Hindi गिनना, Swahili hesabu — the census/enumeration sense used extensively in Numbers.

labelChirho: Qal passive participle: numbered ones, enrollment
descriptionChirho: The Qal passive participle used substantivally for those who have been counted/enrolled in a census (מְפֻקָּדִים); Arabic الْمَعْدُودُونَ, Korean 계수된 자들, Hindi गिनती/गिने गए, Swahili waliohesabiwa.

labelChirho: Qal: visit, attend to, care for
descriptionChirho: To visit someone with gracious attention, care for, look after, remember (positive divine visitation); Arabic افتقد, Korean 돌보다/방문하다, Hindi देखभाल करना/भेंट देना, Swahili tembelea/kumbuka.
To visit with punishment, to bring judgment upon (negative divine visitation); Arabic عاقب, Korean 벌하다, Hindi दण्ड देना/दंड देना, Swahili adhibu.
To appoint someone to a position or charge someone with a task (Qal); Arabic أوصى/أمر, Korean 명하다/임명하다, Hindi नियुक्त करना/ठहराना, Swahili weka/agiza.
Substantival use of the Qal passive participle meaning appointed officer or overseer (פָּקִיד); Arabic وُكَلاء/قُوَّاد, Korean 지휘관/감독, Hindi अधिकारी, Swahili maafisa/waliowekwa juu ya.
To miss someone's presence, to seek or long for (emotional absence); Arabic طلب/تفتقد, Korean 찾다/구하다, Hindi खोजना, Swahili tafuta/kosa.
To be missing, lacking, absent from one's place (Nifal as passive/middle of 'miss/seek'); Arabic يُفقَد/فُقِد, Korean 빠지다/없어지다, Hindi खोया जाना/छूटना, Swahili potea/kosekana.

Passive of divine visitation, whether positive (be visited/cared for) or negative (be punished/judged); Arabic يُفتَقَد/تُصِيب, Korean 방문받다/벌하시다, Hindi दंडित होना/भेंट दिया जाना, Swahili tembelewa/adhibiwa.
Intensive counting — to muster or review troops (Piel); Arabic يُحَشِّد, Korean 점고하다, Hindi गिनती करना, Swahili kagua.
Passive intensive — to be deprived of, to be reckoned/accounted (Pual); Arabic حُرِم/حُسِب, Korean 빼앗기다/기록되다, Hindi छीन लिया जाना/गिनी जाना, Swahili fikiriwa/hesabiwa.
To appoint or install someone in authority over something (Hifil causative); Arabic عَيَّنَ/أقام/وَكَّلَ, Korean 임명하다/세우다, Hindi नियुक्त करना/ठहराना, Swahili weka.
To deposit or entrust something to someone's care (Hifil causative); Arabic أَوْدَعَ, Korean 맡기다/보관하다, Hindi सौंपना/रखना, Swahili weka amri/kabidhi.
Reflexive/passive of counting — to be numbered, enrolled in a census (Hitpael); Arabic يُعَدّ/اُحْصِيَ, Korean 세어지다/계수되다, Hindi गिने जाना, Swahili hesabiwa.
Passive participle of Hifil — those who have been appointed or set in charge (Hofal); Arabic الْمُوَكَّلِينَ, Korean 임명된 자들, Hindi नियुक्त/ठहराए हुए, Swahili waliowekwa.
